test_title: PYST 8: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group.

Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) UQ-VR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5246d47b8bfcdb73f33a73fef1860942a5a3700ef344fcfa86379b8ac1575451.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ef15788fcecfe23d716aee661f9c5e2709a1a3a1cea45a0888644ea662ce7db.png] 

Option 2) QM-RO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11dbffcccef2bcc5d2a8545ccf5151932404119ed2a2b7316b67b31219a46717.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b8ab40f2334f47ee96af6aadf2fbb13a4835239b6e0a2b4570cf0fb2409fb00.png] 

Option 3) SO-TQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33b9a274882ee44a1ca3abf38a5608a0c894c484c33d3a4254d4e912e8094b15.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f1535d0e61fb2d1216e44eb619a9be3df85ea6bc9c240a07994ac3b718c96a4.png] 

Option 4) WS-XU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/077ccbd53010df517efbe5e2b59b1dc5de705e7eb0cbb9661454965cf48d4341.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9bf289f3f7bd1d6947e3d8cb80c15357727ce9d7702419a627ffa034c4d2b7c.png] 

Here, **'UQ-VR'** is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
